title: Blank context-menu entries: Exclude from Search (#1659) and Thumbnail of Group (#574) are half-implemented
author: jafin
body_snippet:
## Summary

`ConnectionContextMenu` contains two `ToolStripMenuItem`s that are constructed and added to `Items` but never given `Text`, `Image`, `Name`, a `Click` handler, or an entry in `ApplyLanguage()`. WinForms renders an empty `ToolStripMenuItem` as a full-height, enabled, clickable row — so users see two blank gaps in the connection tree context menu.

Both were introduced as partial implementations of upstream feature requests:
